text:
amir: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing an \"affinity-mesh\" split to decouple tenant affinity/state from execution. idea is mesh sidecars maintain sticky routing + local prefix cache; stateless executors do model work. aiming to reduce hotpath churn and make tenant-level rollbacks cheaper.

dana: high level migration plan?

amir: Phase A: wire a passive mesh that only observes and shadows traffic (no stray writes). Phase B: enable read-through from mesh for a sampled tenant cohort. Phase C: enable writes to mesh for opt-in tenants. Phase D: flip traffic after confidence.

xi: Concern: double-writes during opt-in. how do we ensure idempotency and ordering for prefix updates?

amir: Mesh sidecars will accept versioned deltas with monotonic sequence numbers; a lightweight sequencer in the router will attach a request-id and seq. We'll also ship a reconciliation job that diffs tenant state daily.

lee: Latency budget: we can't add >1ms median. Mesh RPC looks like an extra hop. can we colocate sidecars on executor hosts?
amir: Yes — prefer co-location on same pod/node when possible. For cross-node cases, we add a fast-path cache TTL on router for last-known mapping to avoid RPC on steady state.

dana: How to warm caches? existing tenants have millions of prefixes. we can't prepopulate everything.
amir: Strategy: 1) heat from traffic (shadow writes create warm entries), 2) backfill top-k prefixes per tenant via offline job, 3) lazy on-first-miss with amortized writes. we'll track heatmap metrics.

xi: What about tenant-specific heuristics currently in enrichment layer? several customers rely on them.
amir: We'll support a small plugin surface in the mesh for heuristic hooks, but default path will be to migrate logic to enrichment adapters over time. For beginning, support a shim that forwards certain keys to legacy enrichment.

lee: Rollout SLOs? ops-safety thresholds?
amir: Start with 0.1% canary during high qps, 3% during low qps for 24h checks. Guard rails: p95 token latency <= baseline + 15%, error rate not increase by more than 0.05% absolute, cache hit ratio not drop by >5ppt. Automatic rollback if any violated for 15 minutes.

dana: Observability checklist: per-tenant request scatter, mesh-hit/miss, seq-failures, cross-host RPC tail, pre/post output-diff. also need synthetic traffic that exercises cold prefixes.

xi: Test harness idea: replay 50k historical sessions w/ traffic amplification and randomized node delays. also run a golden-run diff for top-100 tenants, threshold per-model type.

amir: We'll keep batching centralized at executors. Executors expose batch_hint header so router/mesh can coalesce. Sidecars should not perform batching.

lee: Cost impact: extra network egress, sidecar CPU. suggest rolling out to smallest tenants first and modeling cost delta.
amir: I'll produce a cost delta estimate table: CPU, mem, egress per 1k reqs.

ops-bot: infra note: feature-flag \"affinity_mesh_observe\" created on org config.

dana: Fallback semantics?
amir: Router will support: 1) soft-fail -> use last-known mapping, 2) hard-timeout -> fallback to legacy handler, 3) suppressed-write mode for shadow. Config example:
```
mesh:
  enabled: true
  mode: observe  # observe | read-through | read-write
  timeout_ms: 100
  fallback: legacy-exec
  last_known_cache_ttl_ms: 200
```

xi: Prometheus queries to watch during canary: `sum(rate(mesh_rpc_requests_total[1m])) by (code)`, `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(mesh_rpc_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, host))`, and `sum(rate(affinity_miss_total[5m])) by (tenant)`.

lee: Also add an alert that triggers on sustained seq-replay anomalies and on reconciliation mismatch rate > 0.1%.

amir: Migration job plan: snapshot top-100k prefixes per tenant, stream diffs into mesh store, run nightly reconciliation for 7 days while shadowing 100% traffic to mesh for monitoring only. only flip writes after diffs converge below threshold.

dana: Who owns the plug-in shim and reconciliation job?
amir: I'll own the reconciliation job, @xi will own the shim. tag: @lee for rollout ops.

ops-bot: ticket created: ARCH-5122 \"affinity-mesh rollout plan\" assigned to amir, xi. https://issues.redwood.example/ARCH-5122

xi: I'll prototype a mesh sidecar that exposes an HTTP gRPC shim and a minimal in-memory LRU store with async persistence. plan: 2 week spike.

amir: timeline in doc: spike 2w, infra prep 3w, canary 2w, scale 4-6w. aim to be non-disruptive.

dana: please include canary playbook steps in the RFC follow-up. i'll draft the observability dashboard layout.

amir: Will create follow-up RFC and attach migration playbook, cost estimates, test harness scripts. tagging the reviewers: @dana @xi @lee. :white_check_mark:
